title: fix(metadata-protocol): duplicating a package copies a permission set that grants on an optional plugin's object not installed here
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg3tbthgMt3StL2erC7575Em)_

domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYSw4nSVJDr6XpcWLJ

Fixes #30319

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 复制包（`duplicatePackage`）时，复制出的权限集把源权限集在库中存储的授权对象名作为 `inheritedGrantObjects` 交给保存门，与 #30255 的权限集克隆门同一条规则。没装 plugin-audit 的部署里，授权 `sys_comment` 的权限集现在能随包一起复制；非托管导入按席位裁定 A 保持拒收，未改。
- **为什么改：** 修 #30310 时只改了克隆门，复制包这扇门仍把这类权限集放进 `failed[]`，整次复制回 `success: false`，用户复制一个正常的包却丢了权限集。
- **风险与回滚：** 只放行源行本来就持有的授权键；被命名空间改写过的键（源包自己的对象改名为副本的对象）不算继承，仍照常判；键只从库中的源行取，不读请求。非托管导入的包是请求体，不是存储行，所以仍逐条判（裁定 A）。回滚即撤 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-commits.ts` 的复制门 `saveMetaItem` 调用（`inheritedGrantObjects` 一行）与文件头的 `storedGrantObjectKeys`；再看 `protocol.copy-doors-inherited-grants.test.ts` 的第二个用例（改名后的授权仍拒）。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.copy-doors-inherited-grants.test.ts`，预期 4 个用例全过。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`duplicatePackage`** (`protocol-package-commits.ts`): each copied `permission` item is saved with `inheritedGrantObjects` = the keys of the SOURCE row's `objects` map as stored (`storedGrantObjectKeys(body)`, the raw parsed row, before conversion and rewrite). The save door's unknown-object refusal (#28990) already skips inherited keys since PR #30310 (`protocol-save.ts`, `unknownGrantObjectSaveRefusal`), so a set granting on an optional plugin's object this deployment does not install (`sys_comment` / `sys_activity`, `@objectstack/plugin-audit`) is copied instead of landing in `failed[]`.
  - The keys come from the stored row only; `duplicatePackage`'s request has no such field, exactly as the clone door's (triage 6651966154: "server-derived from the SOURCE set as stored, never read from request input").
  - A key the copy's namespace rewrite renames (`leave_ticket` → `leave_copy_ticket`) is not the source's key, so it is judged as before: when the copied object is not there, the set is still refused, naming that grant alone.
  - `storedGrantObjectKeys` restates the clone door's `inheritedGrantObjectsOf` (two lines): that helper lives in `@objectstack/runtime`, which depends on this package, so it cannot be imported here.
- **`importUnmanagedPackage`**: unchanged in behaviour, with a comment at its save call. By the seat's ruling on #30319 (option A), its package is the request's body, not a stored row, so its permission sets are new writes and every grant is judged; deriving inherited keys from the body would read request input and turn the refusal off for this door.
- One changeset, `patch` for `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (`Metadata-protocol: none`). No published schema moves; a save that was refused now succeeds (`Clause-②: no`).

## Measured first (on `main` at `870ebce3`, before the fix)

Harness: the stateful `sys_metadata` stub of the new test file, registry registering no object (no plugin-audit), a source package `com.example.leave` holding object `leave_ticket` and set `leave_staff` granting `leave_ticket` + `sys_comment`.

<details><summary>Duplicate door — refused (200, success: false, the set in failed[])</summary>

```
"success": false, "copiedCount": 1, "failedCount": 1,
"copied": [{ "type": "object", "name": "leave_copy_ticket" }],
"failed": [{ "type": "permission", "name": "leave_staff",
  "error": "permission/leave_copy_staff failed spec validation: objects.sys_comment: Permission 'leave_copy_staff' grants on object 'sys_comment' which is not defined in objects: no package registers an object of that name and none is saved here, so the grant applies to nothing. …" }]
```
</details>

<details><summary>Unmanaged import — refused (422 INVALID_METADATA, rolled back whole)</summary>

```
422 INVALID_METADATA The unmanaged install of 'com.example.crm' was rolled back: permission 'crm_rep' could not be written — permission/crm_rep failed spec validation: objects.sys_comment: … the new base 'com.example.crm-copy' was removed, so nothing of the package remains.
issues: [{"path":"objects.sys_comment", "code":"custom", …}]
sys_metadata rows after: []
```
</details>

## Tests

`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.copy-doors-inherited-grants.test.ts`, 4 cases:

1. Duplicate: a set granting on `sys_comment` (absent) and the source's own object is copied; the copy grants `leave_copy_ticket` + `sys_comment`.
2. Duplicate: a grant the rewrite renames onto an object that did not copy (`leave_copy_ticket`, its source row unparseable) is still refused — the exact `failed[]` entry, one finding at `objects.leave_copy_ticket`, `sys_comment` not judged; nothing stored.
3. Duplicate: a grant the source holds outside its namespace on an absent object (`other_gone`, not renamed) is the source's and is copied.
4. Unmanaged import: a set granting on `sys_comment` is refused `422 INVALID_METADATA` at `objects.sys_comment` (code, status, path, first sentence) and the import is rolled back (no row, no base) — pinned as intended by ruling A.

Ablations (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation proven on disk, restored to the `HEAD` blob with `git diff HEAD` empty; the test imports `./protocol.js` from source, so no `dist/` is involved):

| Mutation | Expected | Observed |
|---|---|---|
| A. drop the `inheritedGrantObjects` argument at the duplicate door | 1, 3 red | 1, 2, 3 red (2 gains the `sys_comment` finding) |
| B. derive inherited keys from the REWRITTEN copy instead of the stored row | 2 red | 2 red (renamed grant passes), 1/3/4 green |
| C. pass the import body's own keys as `inheritedGrantObjects` at the import door | 4 red | 4 red (import resolves, no 422) |

A first attempt at C was a no-op refused by the tool (replacement contained the anchor; anchor count 1 → 1); re-run with a distinct replacement.

## Verification

All on this branch; the code under test is identical from `83a51faa` to the head (later commits: changeset wording, the engine-double ledger row, a merge of `main`).

- **New pins:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.copy-doors-inherited-grants.test.ts src/protocol.unknown-grant-object-refusal.test.ts` on `c718acd3` (after merging `main` at `7d7babb1`): 23/23.
- **Package suite:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test` on `c718acd3`: Test Files 315 passed, 4 skipped; Tests 22410 passed, 26 skipped. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck`: exit 0 (`--listFiles` includes the new test file).
- **Full dogfood** (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock, closure built first, no shard): Test Files 419 passed, 3 skipped (422); Tests 3492 passed, 36 skipped (3528). Lock VERDICT `command-exit 0`, held 29m40s.
- **Derived gates** (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 67 families on `4463c9f7`): 66 exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED — `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (studio, client-react and five plugin/service packages have no `dist/` in this worktree); left to CI. `--ran` reconciliation: "67 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 66 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED". `check:engine-double-contract` asked for the new test file's doubles to be recorded: `--write` added one seam row set, committed. After the merge, `node scripts/check-engine-double-contract.mjs` exit 0.
- **`pnpm lint`:** exit 0 on `4463c9f7`.
